description: Exposes compiled stencil pack components to the wireframe component registry. Implements IWireframeScopedComponentProvider, so a pack's component types are namespaced to one application.

examples.title: Serve a stencil pack to the registry

members.name: StencilPackComponentProvider
members.type: StencilPackComponentProvider(StencilPack pack, string? scopeAppIdOrNamespace = null, int priority = 50)
members.description: Compiles the pack and exposes its components. Priority defaults to 50, above BuiltInStencilPackProvider (0).

members.name: StencilPackComponentProvider
members.type: StencilPackComponentProvider(StencilPack pack, UiRoleVocabulary roleVocabulary, string? scopeAppIdOrNamespace = null, int priority = 50)
members.description: Same, but resolves UI roles through the supplied vocabulary.
